quotations.old_english: Þone æftran dæg mid his nihte on bénum hé þurhstód
quotations.latin: secundo die cum nocte subsequent in precibus perstitit

source_text: þurh-standan to persist, continue :-- Þone æftran dæg mid his nihte on bénum hé þurhstód secundo die cum nocte subsequent in precibus perstitit, Gr. D. 200, 8.
